collection.label: Dhammapada
collection.author_name: Attributed to the Buddha; Pali canon (Khuddakanikāya)
collection.search_terms: dhammapada pali buddha buddhist verses khuddakanikaya yamaka twin verses max muller sinhalese palm leaf
collection.description: The complete Dhammapada, 423 verses in 26 chapters: the Pali text and Max Müller's 1881 English, each verse on the page of a Sinhalese palm-leaf manuscript in the John Rylands Library, Manchester (Pali MS 19), that carries it.
